## Windows Rug v1.4.2

The living room now actually shows up, arranged around the rug.

![The living room around the rug](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justahmmed/windows-rug/main/docs/room.jpg)

### Fixes

- **Furniture was invisible.** Each piece drew itself before its window was shown, and Windows cleared it on show (only the lamp's glow appeared). Furniture and found items now draw after they appear.
- **A room around the rug.** The coffee table sits in the middle of the rug, the corner sofa wraps around its bottom-right corner, the lamp stands beside the sofa and the plant by the rug's far corner. Rooms saved with the old corner layout are rearranged once, automatically. *Reset room* uses the same arrangement.

### Install

1. Download **WindowsRug.zip** below and extract it.
2. Open the extracted folder and double-click **Install.bat** inside it.
